messages:
Alex (AE): Hey team — HelioHealth wants to sign this week. Three must-haves: KMS integration (they use Azure Key Vault), PO on net60, and they want SOC2 addendum in the DPA. Any blockers on routing/signature or finance approvals?
Jordan (SE): Got it. Are they going hosted or private? KMS integration affects Private workflow; hosted supports BYOK via KMS token exchange but we need SRE signoff.
Alex (AE): They're aiming for our Dedicated offering (private VPC). Procurement insists on Azure KV and key custody. Signature path they want: procurement -> legal -> CISO -> exec.
Maria (Legal): Noted. Net60 is unusual; standard is net30/net45. We can try to make net60 conditional on a revenue ops review. Also need to see their SOC2 addendum language. Can you drop their suggested DPA clauses here?
Sam (Finance): Net60 needs RevOps approval. Also need the PO number and billing contact before routing. If this is reserved capacity, pricing/commit terms will matter for recognition.
Alex (AE): Billing contact: dana@heliohealth.com. PO TBD (they said will issue one after MSA). I'll ask them for the DPA snippet.
Jordan (SE): FYI for docs — if Private + Azure KV, we must include KMS integration steps in the Order Form: key ID, tenant ID, and rotation policy. Example snippet below I can drop into the order form.
Jordan (SE): ```
Order Form: HelioHealth
- Product: Redwood Dedicated
- Region: us-west-2 (private)
- Billing: Per-month reserved capacity
- KMS: Azure Key Vault (customer-managed)
  - Required: key_vault_id, subscription_id, tenant_id
  - Rotation: customer-managed / 90 days recommended
- Payment Terms: Net60 (pending RevOps approval)
```
Maria (Legal): Please add this DPA clause for BYOK/KMS: `Customer KMS keys will be used solely for encryption of customer data in transit and at rest; Redwood will not export or retain key material.` I want to see the customer's legal draft before final sign.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created for HelioHealth MSA (env_0a1b2c). Status: draft. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_0a1b2c
Alex (AE): I asked Helio to send over their SOC2 addendum and the PO. They said they can route DocuSign envelope to procurement first. Is that routing configured? 
Jordan (SE): We can set envelope workflow to route to procurement -> legal -> ciso -> exec. Need emails for each approver; procurement = procurement@heliohealth.com, legal = legal@heliohealth.com, ciso = ciso@heliohealth.com, exec = ceo@heliohealth.com
Sam (Finance): Once the PO number is in, I'll queue RevOps for Net60 approval. If RevOps denies, propose net45 + early payment discount.
Maria (Legal): I'll prep redlines for MSA + DPA with the KMS clause and a conditional Net60 fallback to Net45. Sending to contracts@redwood.com and cc: alex@redwood.com. Target: EOD today.
Alex (AE): Thanks. If Legal approves, I'll trigger esign-bot to send envelope to procurement first. Everyone please react with :white_check_mark: when ready.
Jordan (SE): I'll update the order form and attach to the envelope. ETA 3 hours.
Sam (Finance): Marking for RevOps review when PO lands.
Maria (Legal): If Helio insists on an alternate KMS phrase, route it to me immediately. Otherwise I will finalize and respond to Alex.
Alex (AE): Appreciate it — will follow up with customer for PO and their SOC2 addendum. Keep me posted. :thumbsup:
